# A gtk4 program in C runs its tests in the C test agent (pkg/c/runtime):
# each test builds the program, and a click is GTK's "clicked", which reaches
# the closure GLib holds through its dispatcher, the closure's state the box
# NoRef made of the component's var.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A slot renders into a box no class declared the append and remove of:
# the card's `if` takes its body out of the card's box and puts it back
# before its anchor, and a window under `if` is rendered into the
# application, SNGL_APP, which the runtime's box calls attach to and detach
# from it.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c slots.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A timer is a GLib timeout armed with the closure its effect mounts, whose
# body is the program's @tick handler: NoLambda leaves a lambda that emits
# to the inliner that answers the emit. A test's wait runs GTK's loop, and
# each test tears down the one before, so its timer ticks no later test's
# state.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c timer.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A canvas's click is a GtkGestureClick's press, which a test makes through
# the handler rt keeps on the drawing area (testdata/gtk4_c_canvas.txtar).

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c canvas.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A test's value is written into the widget as a user's edit would: a flip's
# state set, which fires the signal, and an entry's text put there with its
# "changed" blocked before the test fires it. A switch reports through
# notify::active, which connects like any signal.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c controls.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A scroll's end arriving is no signal: rt's scroll.c reads it off the
# adjustments, and a test fires the handler rt keeps. Its direction is the
# member's name, which NoEnum writes in place of the ordinal a string of an
# enum would otherwise format as.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c scroll.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A window's @key hears a key a test presses through rt's toplevel, as the
# program's handler takes it: the name a string, and rt's stop a closure the
# handler calls. The test's stop writes a local of the test's, which the
# lambda C lifts reaches through its address. int(s) and float(s) read the
# whole of s, and are 0 where it is no number.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c keys.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #count(text="{n}", @click {
            n += 1
        })
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testClickReachesTheClosure(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.count.click()
    c.count.click()
    t.assert(c.n == 2)
}
-- slots.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component card(name = "") ui.node {
    var open = true
    ui.button #toggle(text=name, @click {
        open = !open
    })
    if open {
        ui.text(value="body of " + name)
    }
}

var details = false

ui.window(title="t") {
    card(name="a")
}

if details {
    ui.window(title="details") {
        ui.text(value="more")
    }
}

func testToggleRemovesAndRestoresTheBody(t test.Test, c card) {
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(!c.open)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.open)
}
-- timer.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import time "sngl:time"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var (
        beats = 0
        running = true
    )
    time.timer(interval=100ms, enabled=running, @tick {
        beats += 1
    })
    ui.text(value="{beats}")
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testTheTimerRunsTheHandler(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.wait(func() => c.beats >= 2, 2000)
    t.assert(c.beats >= 2)
}

func testTheGateStopsTheTimer(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.running = false
    t.wait(func() => c.beats > 0, 300)
    t.assert(c.beats == 0)
}
-- canvas.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component dot(r float) ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        draw.canvas(width=40px, height=40px) {
            draw.circle(cx=20.0, cy=20.0, r=r + float(n))
        }
        ui.button(text="grow", @click {
            n += 1
        })
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var hits = 0
    var rs = [4.0, 8.0]
    ui.vbox {
        draw.canvas #board(width=40px, height=40px, scalingMode=draw.ScalingMode.fit, @click {
            hits += 1
        }) {
            draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=float(hits), h=10.0, style=draw.Style{lineCap=draw.LineCap.round})
        }
        for var r = rs {
            dot(r=r)
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testClickRedraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.board.click()
    c.board.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 2)
}
-- controls.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var on = false
    var dark = false
    var name = "a"
    var changes = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.checkbox #box(label="x", checked=on, @change(v) {
            on = v
            changes += 1
        })
        ui.toggle #flip(checked=dark, @change(v) {
            dark = v
        })
        ui.input #field(value=name, @input(v) {
            name = v
        })
        ui.text(value="{name} {on}")
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testValuesReachTheHandlers(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.box.change(true)
    t.assert(c.on)
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
    c.flip.change(true)
    t.assert(c.dark)
    c.field.input("bee")
    t.assert(c.name == "bee")
}
-- keys.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component app root {
    var typed = ""
    var total = 0.0
    var count = 0
    ui.window #win(title="t", @key(e, stop) {
        if e.ctrl {
            return
        }
        typed = typed + e.key
        total += float(e.key)
        count += int(e.key)
        if e.key == "x" {
            stop()
        }
    }) {
        ui.text(value=typed)
    }
}

app()

func testKeysReachTheWindow(t test.Test, c app) {
    var stopped = 0
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="7"}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="x"}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="s", ctrl=true}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="2.5"}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    t.assert(c.typed == "7x2.5")
    t.assert(stopped == 1)
    t.assert(c.total == 9.5)
    t.assert(c.count == 7)
}
-- scroll.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var rows = [1, 2, 3]
    var asked = 0
    var way = ui.ScrollDirection.vertical
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #label(value="{way}")
        ui.scroll #list(direction=way, @reachEnd {
            asked += 1
            rows.push(asked + 3)
        }) {
            ui.vbox {
                for var r = rows {
                    ui.text(value="row {r}")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testTheEndAsksForMore(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.list.reachEnd()
    t.assert(c.asked == 1)
}

func testADirectionIsItsName(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(string(c.way) == "vertical")
    c.way = ui.ScrollDirection.both
    t.assert(string(c.way) == "both")
    t.assert("{c.way}" == "both")
}
